item.title: Version 1.0.31
item.description:
fix + feat: 15-min check-in now discoverable + reliable

Bug: every time the Mac re-polled the active session from the
server, the check-in button silently disappeared mid-flip because
the server response field wasn't being decoded.  Mac now reads
check_in_enabled + check_in_active_until from the server payload
and restores the FlipSession with the correct state.

Discoverability: when you slide a Focus session to 4hr+ or pick
any Unplug duration in ModesView, a new "✓ INCLUDES ONE 15-MIN
CHECK-IN" hint appears below the duration picker.  No more
mystery feature.
